For us it means naming the plant and the part used. We aim to publish ingredient identity in full, show real test reports when they exist, and keep tradition and evidence apart. This website does not yet display any certifications, laboratory results or approvals.

q: What is the difference between traditional Ayurvedic use and clinical evidence?
a: Traditional use describes how a plant has been used within a system of practice such as Ayurveda; it is not a measurement of effect. Clinical evidence comes from studies of a specific preparation, dose and group of people, and applies only as far as those details allow. We describe each for what it is, and our products are in development, so we make no health claims about them.
